title: Synthetic literal passwords in database connection URIs
summary: The same connection URI shapes as the tutorial defaults (postgres, mysql, mariadb and others) with a synthetic random-looking password in the user-info position.
rationale: The exemption for tutorial passwords must depend on the password, not on the URI shape. A real literal in an identical URI is a leak, and only the password bytes are secret: reporting just the scheme and host, or stopping early, leaves the password exposed.

expectation.rationale: Flagged, and the range must cover the password. The value is not a known tutorial default and is assigned in the one position where a connection URI holds a secret.
